title: Orange Creamsicle Ice Cream Cake
changes_from_base: A wafer base under swirled spoonfuls of bought orange sherbet and vanilla ice cream, instead of sponge and layered ice cream.
summary: A playful orange and vanilla ice cream cake with a crunchy wafer base, swirled into peaks reminiscent of a classic creamsicle.

ingredients.item: vanilla wafer biscuits (about 70 g), plus more as needed

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Let 950 ml orange sherbet and 950 ml vanilla ice cream stand at room temperature while you prepare the base.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Cover the base of the springform tin with the vanilla wafer biscuits, breaking some to fill any gaps.

steps.title: Dollop
steps.text: Drop small, alternating spoonfuls of sherbet and ice cream over the biscuits at random, pressing down gently with the back of a spoon and tapping the tin on the worktop to knock out air and fill gaps.

steps.title: Swirl
steps.text: Level the surface, then press the back of the spoon in and lift it up and out in circles to create swirls and peaks.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Cover and freeze for at least 2 h.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Rub the side and base of the tin with a warm damp tea towel, release the ring and move the cake to a plate to serve.

tips: Let the sherbet and ice cream soften slightly at room temperature so they are easy to spoon and press together.
Tap the tin firmly on the worktop as you build the layers to knock out any air pockets.
Run a warm damp tea towel around the tin before releasing the springform ring so the cake comes out cleanly.
storage: Keep the cake covered in the freezer for up to 1 week.
